requirements.statement: Regenerating scripts/test-requirements.json with scripts/generate_test_metadata.py --catalogue on the current tree is a no-op: byte-identical output that keeps every hand-registered requirement and check (including L14.1 and L15.1).
The generator output order and formatting are deterministic: requirements sorted by id, checks sorted, fixed indentation, and two runs give identical bytes.
Requirements whose source is tests/requirements/<name>.json (for example ap5-lookup, s14e, s15) are included in the generated catalogue with that source and statement.
